description: This file contains implementation of NTLM authentication functions, including hash generation, response creation, and target info updates, for the net::ntlm namespace.

methods.name: UpdateTargetInfoAvPairs
methods.description: Updates target info AV pairs with flags, timestamp, channel bindings, and SPN based on parameters.

methods.name: WriteUpdatedTargetInfo
methods.description: Serializes AV pairs into a buffer with terminator.

methods.name: Splay56To64
methods.description: Converts 7-byte (56-bit) key to 8-byte (64-bit) key with parity bits.

methods.name: Create3DesKeysFromNtlmHash
methods.description: Creates three DES keys from NTLM hash for encryption.

methods.name: GenerateResponseDesl
methods.description: Generates NTLM response using DES encryption with challenge.

methods.name: GenerateNtlmResponseV1
methods.description: Generates NTLMv1 response from password and server challenge.

methods.name: GenerateLMResponseV1WithSessionSecurity
methods.description: Generates LM response with session security.

methods.name: GenerateSessionHashV1WithSessionSecurity
methods.description: Generates session hash for NTLMv1 with session security.

methods.name: GenerateNtlmResponseV1WithSessionSecurity
methods.description: Generates NTLM response with session security.

methods.name: GenerateResponsesV1WithSessionSecurity
methods.description: Generates LM and NTLM responses with session security.

methods.name: GenerateNtlmHashV2
methods.description: Generates NTLMv2 hash from domain, username, and password.

methods.name: GenerateProofInputV2
methods.description: Creates proof input buffer for NTLMv2.

methods.name: GenerateUpdatedTargetInfo
methods.description: Creates updated target info with optional MIC and EPA.
